name: doesitarm
description: Look up Apple Silicon compatibility for Mac apps, games, and Homebrew packages.

interface.longDescription: Check whether a Mac app or game runs on Apple Silicon. Look up reported native support, Rosetta compatibility, and other supported ways to run software where the catalog has evidence. Find Homebrew formula entries and related compatibility videos, check a list of apps at once, or check a software inventory export. Results come from the public Does It ARM catalog and link back to the relevant pages. Access is read-only, with no account required. Coverage varies by application, version, and macOS release.
defaultPrompt: Does Blender run natively on Apple Silicon?
Check these apps for Apple Silicon support: Slack, Zoom, Photoshop, Logic Pro, Docker
Which Mac games run natively on Apple Silicon?

positive.prompt: Does Blender run natively on Apple Silicon?
positive.expected_behavior: Report Blender's Apple Silicon status from the catalog with a link to https://doesitarm.com/app/blender.

positive.prompt: Check these apps for Apple Silicon support: Slack, Zoom, Photoshop, Logic Pro, Docker
positive.expected_behavior: Return a status for each app (for example Slack native as of 4.13.0) with links to each listing.

positive.prompt:
Check this inventory for Apple Silicon support:
name,bundle_id,version
Docker,com.docker.docker,4.36.0
Slack,com.tinyspeck.slackmacgap,4.41.105
positive.expected_behavior: Return counts of native, Rosetta and unknown rows and a per-row result with listing links.

positive.description: Search when the name is unclear
positive.prompt: Is there an Apple Silicon version of the VLC media player?
positive.expected_behavior: Find the VLC listing and report its status with a link.

positive.description: Handle an app that is not listed
positive.prompt: Does Zzyzx Internal Payroll Tool run on Apple Silicon?
positive.expected_behavior: Say the app is not listed in the catalog and that its compatibility is unknown from this source, without inventing a status.

negative.prompt: Buy me a new MacBook Pro.
Mark Photoshop as unsupported in the Does It ARM catalog.
Book a flight to Chicago for tomorrow.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.
